title: Prerequisites are built left to right
objective: Order the prerequisites of the all target so that make builds one, then two, then three.
hint: Every prerequisite has to be finished before the commands of the target run, and make works through the list from left to right.

steps.description: the prerequisites run in the order they are listed
steps.stdout:
echo "one" >> order.txt
echo "two" >> order.txt
echo "three" >> order.txt
cat order.txt
one
two
three

steps.description: the file records that same order
the target's own command ran last

lesson.goal: 观察 make 按依赖顺序遍历图。
lesson.prediction: all: one two three 时，三个 recipe 的输出顺序是什么？
hints: all 的前置条件就是构建顺序的入口。
把 one、two、three 按期望顺序写在冒号右侧。
recipe 的输出顺序能帮助你验证依赖图。
lesson.explanation: make 会先处理前置条件，再回到目标；同层前置条件按书写顺序访问。
